summary: If mesh-CA.crt (/etc/receptor/tls/ca/ on RPM, $HOME/aap/receptor/etc/ on containerized) holds more than 10 certificates an error occurs: back it up, keep only the first certificate, and restart receptor on every controller and execution node.
questions: Error with too many certificates in mesh-CA.crt
How do I fix multiple signed certificates in receptor?
Where is mesh-CA.crt on a containerized install?

answer_card.title: Fix mesh-CA.crt with more than 10 certificates
answer_card.answer_md:
On every controller and execution node:
```bash
# RPM
cp -p /etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.crt /etc/receptor/tls/ca/mesh-CA.crt-$(date +%F)
# keep only the first certificate in the file, then
systemctl restart receptor

# Containerized
cp -p $HOME/aap/receptor/etc/mesh-CA.crt $HOME/aap/receptor/etc/mesh-CA.crt-$(date +%F)
# keep only the first certificate, then
systemctl --user restart receptor
```
